verses.t: By the sky and the night comer

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the night comer
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is

verses.t: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector

verses.t: So let man observe from what he was created

verses.t: He was created from a fluid, ejected

verses.t: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs
